stories.title: Sen. Mark Kelly, Olivia Munn introduce ‘Know Your Risk Act’
stories.summary: Sen. Mark Kelly, D-Ariz., is introducing the “Know Your Risk Act,” legislation meant to help women learn their breast cancer risk and detect the disease early.

stories.summary: Prince Waikiki is bringing a taste of its popular 100 Sails brunch to Bloomingdale’s at Ala Moana Center for two weekends.

stories.title: Nearly all Maui wildfire claimants accept $4 billion settlement, attorneys say
stories.summary: Attorneys for Maui wildfire survivors say the vast majority have chosen to accept settlement offers.

stories.title: What grocery stores are open on Thanksgiving? Your 2026 guide
stories.summary: Several grocery stores will remain open, albeit with modified hours, in case you forgot something.

stories.title: First Alert Forecast: Windy, wet weekend ahead
stories.summary: We’re off to a breezy day with trade winds and passing showers statewide.

stories.title: Four Hawaii judo athletes prepare to represent Team USA in Mexico
stories.summary: Four young Tenri Judo athletes are preparing to represent Team USA at a Pan American competition in Cancún, Mexico, after qualifying at the Junior Olympics.

stories.title: Person rescued from vehicle after crash in Haleiwa
stories.summary: A person was rescued from a motor vehicle early Saturday morning after a crash in Haleiwa.

stories.title: Man accused of pouring toxic oil into woman’s Waffle House drink before child drank from it, reports say
stories.summary: A Florida man is accused of pouring essential oil into a woman’s Waffle House drink, which a child later drank from, according to multiple reports.

stories.title: Police use drone to locate knife-wielding suspect in Chinatown
stories.summary: Honolulu police used a drone to locate a man who was waving a knife in Chinatown before officers took him into custody.

stories.title: NTSB: Improper maintenance led to deadly 2024 Kamaka Air crash
stories.summary: The NTSB says a flap-system failure and maintenance problems led to the 2024 crash that killed two pilots near Honolulu’s airport.

stories.title: Family to honor Marlon ‘Uncle Malone’ Ramones after fatal moped crash
stories.summary: The family of 62-year-old Marlon “Uncle Malone” Ramones, who died after being hit on his moped on Oct. 26, is planning to honor his life.
